game_concept: A strategy race set in The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter, the lively tavern district: the town guard must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while siege rats close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter: the lively tavern district
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Quarter, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while siege rats close in. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the town guard ahead. Then check the score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the market bell by solving code steps involving score that move the town guard forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the market bell first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Tavern Quarter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Tavern Quarter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
